import React from 'react'; function Services() { return (

Our Services

Rooftop Systems

We offer 1KW to 500KW installations for industries, commercial buildings, and residential applications.

Ground-Mounted Systems

We provide large-scale installations ranging from 1MW to 100MW for optimal energy generation.

Solar Parks

We specialize in solar parks under the PM Kusum Yojna, helping farmers and organizations create sustainable energy solutions.

Solar Pumps

Submersible, open well, and monoblock solar pumps designed to provide reliable and efficient irrigation solutions.

Solar Street Lights

Cost-effective and durable solar street lighting solutions for streets, communities, and industrial areas.
